brief.name: Mimic Panel
brief.hypothesis: The mimic-line grammar (one track per sequence, lamps as stops, a timetable margin, and #6dff9c only for now and live) was among the freshest structures in the hall of fame. Its record says it lost points on execution, not on the idea: plates floating on bare black, a one-sided chat, an action stranded on a line, rails that overran their last lamp, a lavender accent and a thin type scale. Built again with every one of those fixed and all of its lines kept, it should compete with the leaders on execution while keeping a structure none of them has.
brief.brief: START FROM the mimic-line design in the hall of fame: its palette /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r8/palettes/r7-idea-2.json and its templates /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r8/variants/r7-idea-2/ (read-only there; copy both to your id in this round). Its shots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r8/out/r7-idea-2/shots/, and every judge's scores, reasons and fixes for it are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r7/results.json and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r8/results.json under the id r7-idea-2: read them. KEEP ALL OF ITS LINES, as a system on every page: the bar's bottom rule with its dot under the current page; the page-head line that rings each page's icon and turns its rounded corner under the head; Home's horizontal Coming up track with the lit now lamp and ringed stops; the vertical To do track with its lamps and its timetable margin; Chat's thread hanging from Vera's mark and ending in a ring at the message box; the tracks on Status, Plans, setup and Sign in; and the lamp legend (hollow ring to come, lit sage for done, amber for needs a look, red for off, #6dff9c only for now and live). APPLY THE JUDGES' FIXES (informed mutations): (1) Ground the page: put the plates and the stops on a green-black slate tray behind each track section (about #0f1519 trays, #161c20 plates, edges #2e343b), Status's columns included, so grounded colour carries Home below the fold and Status rather than thin plates on bare black. Tint each idea plate faintly with its kind. (2) Chat keeps its track but gets its two sides back: the family's bubbles right of the track and flush right with a 3px accent bar, Vera's on green-black glass with a faint brand edge. (3) Ideas: keep the head line ringing the icon and holding the controls, but put 'Add an idea' on the title's baseline at the right, never on the line's elbow, and keep the tabs in source order after 'Save a thought'. (4) End every track on its last lamp: no rail runs past its final stop. (5) The timetable margin gets about 7.5rem and one-line stamps (nowrap). Below 40rem, fold the times into the plate head so the phone keeps its bubble measure. (6) Move the lavender and blue-pewter accent to a steel-cyan (about #a7c4d8, checked against every section floor), for links, rings and 'here'. (7) Keep the bar's dot, and also mark the current page clearly: its label in the heading colour and a short lit segment of the rule under it, centred on the dot. (8) Bring Lately added and the kids' wishes onto the track as stops (each kind's ring as the lamp), so the grammar holds on all of Home. (9) A real type scale: page titles clearly above section heads, section heads clearly above body; the rule under each masthead sits under the title, not the deck; one-line stamps in tabular mono. (10) Plates answer the pointer: a hover and the afterglow, as the other cards have. Nowrap Next up's '4 more on the radar' line and the radar's distances. To do's edit folds at 2.75rem targets. (11) A thinner, squarer monitor case with fine detail (a groove, vents, a power LED) rather than the thick rounded pewter slab. NAME: give it a new name of two or three words. Its tagline, concept, companions, strengths and weaknesses describe the design on its own terms, without naming any earlier entrant or its id.
brief.borrows: The mimic-line design (r7-idea-2) in full, with its lines; Signal Galley's slate trays; the judges' recorded fixes from rounds 7 and 8.
brief.avoids: Plates on bare black, the one-sided chat, 'Add an idea' on the elbow, rails overrunning their last lamp, the lavender accent, the thin type scale, the thick case.
